name: valve_citadel_door_shutters
note: EP1 Citadel giant shutters (ep1_citadel_03, the core control room's window onto the core): a window 304 wide and 448 high in a Combine metal frame, with the glass behind it, shut by six func_door leaves 56 wide and 480 high, 36 brushes, overlapping 16; they part from the middle and slide sideways very slowly (speed 10 and 12), the middle pair furthest (119), the next 88, the outer 55, so they bunch at the jambs; all open in about 10.5 s. Taken shut as static slabs ('live': the leaf's name). Anchor: the window's centre on the control room floor (the leaves go down to 64 under it), on the wall plane; faces -x (the room), the core lies at +x. Wiring in 'wiring': read prefabs.md, 'Pieces with their wiring'.
